title: Twelve Dozen Cookies

slices.alt: Comic, part 1 of 12: Verdict Picks Toon: Twelve Dozen Cookies Caption: December. Grandma June bakes cookies for the whole street. Grandma June: Twelve dozen this year. My arm gave up at six.
Comic, part 2 of 12: Jo: It's Black Friday. I'm getting you a stand mixer. Grandma June: A real one? Oh, Jo.
Comic, part 3 of 12: Caption: Three KitchenAid tilt-head models. Same shape. Different model numbers. Jo: The little one must be the cheap one.
Comic, part 4 of 12: Vera: Not even close. (Sound: !!)

Comic, part 5 of 12: Board, Prices seen, Nov 19 to 27, 2026: Classic, 4.5 qt (Target, Nov 27) $279.99; Artisan Mini, 3.5 qt (KitchenAid.com) $329.99; Artisan, 5 qt (Target, Nov 27) $349.99 Sources: target.com, Nov 27, 2026; KitchenAid.com sale, Nov 19, 2026 (via The Dialed-In Home).
Comic, part 6 of 12: Grandma June: The SMALL one costs MORE?

Comic, part 7 of 12: Caption: And the number on the bowl is not what fits in it. Vera: A test kitchen measured what each bowl really works with. Board, Usable bowl space, measured: Classic (4.5 qt on the box) 3.25 qt; Artisan (5 qt on the box) 3 qt; Artisan Mini (3.5 qt on the box) 1.9 qt Source: America's Test Kitchen, The Best Stand Mixers of 2026 (Oct 1, 2026).
Comic, part 8 of 12: Vera: KitchenAid says the Classic and Artisan make up to 9 dozen cookies a batch. The Mini, 5. Grandma June: So twelve dozen is two batches either way.
Comic, part 9 of 12: Jo: And Grandma's Christmas bread? Vera: For stiff bread dough every week, KitchenAid points to a bowl-lift. The 5.5-quart is $299.99 at Target today.
Comic, part 10 of 12: Caption: The decision: the Classic. Cookies, cakes and the odd loaf, for $70 less than the Artisan. Grandma June: That's a lot of butter.

Comic, part 11 of 12: Caption: One rule from KitchenAid's manual: yeast dough goes on speed 2. Never higher. Vera: Higher speeds strain the motor. Speed 2, and patience. Caption: Verdict Picks: KitchenAid Classic vs Artisan vs Mini, and the price to wait for.
Comic, part 12 of 12: Which mixer, and what price is worth it? The four models, side by side, are below.
